newsitem.title: NORWAY: Sysdeco on Oslo bourse watch list due Morgan links.
newsitem.headline: Sysdeco on Oslo bourse watch list due Morgan links.

text.p: The Oslo bourse on Thursday said it had transferred international software house Sysdeco Group ASA to its observation list following information from Morgan Grenfell Asset Management Ltd (MGAM) that the group may hold 51 percent of the Norwegian company.
Under Norwegian securities regulations, a company is obliged to make an offer to the remaining shareholders once it has acquired 45 percent or more of the issued equity in a concern.
Morgan Grenfell issued a statement to the Oslo bourse on Thursday saying that enquiries into three of its investment funds had revealed the share holding.

"In the course of these enquiries MGAM has become aware that group holding in Sysdeco Group ASA may total approximately 51 percent of its issued share capital...MGAM is in discussions concerning the results of its enquiries and their implications," the company said.
Three MGAM funds -- MG European Growth Trust, MG Europa and Dublin-listed MG European Capital Growth -- are under investigation for possible irregularities.
